messages:
Jules: hit a weird onboarding snag with the Next.js starter (app router + edge). first request after a fresh vercel preview returns 401 from the SDK.
Jules: local dev and serverless functions are fine. only edge runtime preview seems flaky.
Ishaan: which client? the unified js one?
Jules: `@redwood/inference@0.13.1` bundled into the page route.
Nora: any logs?
Jules: pasted snippet in issue: `Error: unauthorized
 at fetchRefresh (/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/edge-adapter.js:32:10)`
Jules: interestingly the second attempt succeeds consistently. looks like no retry on the edge path.
DevEx Bot: Note: internal KB on edge refresh ordering: https://intranet.redwood/edge-refresh-ordering (ops tip).
Ishaan: likely parity gap between node adapter and edge adapter. node path uses a refresh-mutex and single retry. edge skips the retry to avoid background threads.
Nora: short-term workaround for the starter: add `/api/refresh` server endpoint and on 401 call it then retry. add snippet to README.
Jules: posted a minimal repro app in the starter repo and linked the failing preview. issue: https://git.redwood/next-starter/issues/88
Tariq: we should add a unit test mocking global fetch that returns 401 then 200 to ensure parity.
Ishaan: plan: (1) implement refresh mutex in edge adapter, (2) add single automatic retry on 401, (3) expose opt-in env var `REDWOOD_EDGE_DEFER_REFRESH` for backward compat.
Nora: also add a small smoketest in the eval harness that deploys the starter to a disposable preview and fetches `/api/generate` once to catch regressions. make it optional to avoid brittleness.
Jules: I'll open the starter PR with README guidance + repro link.
Ishaan: assigning the SDK patch to me. will include changelog and migration note.
DevEx Bot: CI suggestion: add `ci/vercel-preview-smoke.yml` template to devex repo for teams to opt-in.
Tariq: once PRs land, update the starter template pinned version and ping platform for a canary release.
Nora: thanks everyone — this was a big onboarding friction. :sparkles:
